notes.title: Thank You for A Great My Lovely Empress Release Day!
notes.content:

In case you missed it my liege, My Lovely Empress is out now! 

We want thank everyone who took part in giving us such an amazing launch day. We're overjoyed that so many of you joined us in sowing death and destruction upon Ashuwa 🔥

notes.content:

To commemorate My Lovely Empress's formal addition to the My Lovely Family, we are pleased to announce a brand new bundle of dark delights for our most committed! 

The [b]My Lovely Series Bundle[/b] will ALSO be launching on August 21st and will provide players with an additional [b]15% discount[/b] on top of any other discounts running!. 

Featuring My Lovely Daughter, My Lovely Wife, AND a freshly released My Lovely Empress - it will be your opportunity to gather the entire family in one fell swoop. This is a 'complete the set' bundle so if you already own the first two games in the series, the 10% discount will apply to you too. 

BUT that's not all! If art and music are your passion, the My [b]Lovely Empress Deluxe Edition[/b] will include both the Artbook and the Original Soundtrack for your enjoyment. 

We are enthusiastically counting down the days until the 21st of August, and we hope you are too. Thank you all once again for joining us on this journey. 

Every Wishlist counts for games like these, so keep 'em coming! 

~ Neon Doctrine 🖤

notes.title: For Existing Players Not Getting the ReBorn Update.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We have received some reports of the My Lovely Daughter: ReBorn DLC not automatically being added to the accounts of existing players. 

If you are experiencing this, you might need to tick the DLC in the games properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31818974/67552a2c479fb65c337af4b1684ddee23cc69a69.png[/img]

If the DLC is not there, then please send us a screenshot of your My Lovely Daughter Steam license so we can provide you with a key. 

[b]The best way to contact us is to Direct Message our community manager Neon Lucy, who can be found via the Neon Doctrine Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/nd]https://discord.gg/nd[/url][/b]

How to check your steam license: 
[olist]
[*] press windows+R
[*] type in steam://open/console and press enter

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31818974/0af5287b33b006255cf7698417746160edd1b753.png[/img]
[*] [On Steam Console] type in: licenses_for_app 580170 and press enter

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31818974/c930cfa728d083b7c09c9b2e3d950003667c5340.png[/img]
[/olist]
Send us a screenshot like the one above with your SteamID visible to verify you have not received the DLC. 

We hope those of you who have received the update are enjoying the upgraded artwork, and hopefully the rest of you will be enjoying them shortly! 

~ Neon Doctrine 🤍

notes.title: Free "Sacrificial Sons Update" is now Live!
notes.content:
[i]Return to the shoes of Faust, an amnesiac alchemist and a father who wakes up to find their daughter having passed away. His soul gripped by the madness that can only come from grief, he embarks on a quest to rebuild her... by creating homunculi daughters, bonding with them, then murdering them to harvest their souls. [/i]
[previewyoutube=TPdS-Pt6Gn0;full][/previewyoutube]
But the destructive path you walk on will no longer just be paved with the corpses of little girls. With the Sacrificial Sons update, you can now create homunculi sons to keep you company, do your bidding, and ultimately die for you just like the girls have. Once more you’ll have to answer: What are you willing to do to get your daughter back? 

[h3]Did we mention a 65% discount as well?[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/580170/My_Lovely_Daughter/

notes.title: New Homunculus Interactions, Controller Support, and a Teaser for Future Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31818974/5d972b869b5cdbf0cccbf133262304d86f1fb0a0.png[/img]
Hello, our lovely friends!

Thank you for your feedback for the controller support - beta version of My Lovely Daughter. The feature is now available along with other additional small improvements on the latest version of the game (Ver. 1.06). Here’s the complete list of changes:

[list]
[*] Added controller support (Xinput: e.g. Xbox One or Xbox 360 joystick)
[*] Added Homunculus interactions when Faust spends time with them.
[*] Our composer has fine-tuned most of the BGM and SFX.
[*] Added new expressions to villagers.
[/list]

We are now moving on to work on a bigger and story-filled update for the game. Here’s a small teaser for a new character that will be visiting the Salach village soon in the update. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31818974/8b4e9a517924e1f0019f17c6c401ffc5a9e31f00.jpg[/img]

See you all on the next announcement! For more discussion, you can visit the Steam forum discussion or join our Discord channel at https://discord.gg/toge

notes.title: Beta access for controller support update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31818974/23fc31dd2521591639e778e9846e8c27283bb713.png[/img]

Hello, our lovely players!

We are currently working on adding controller support for [i]My Lovely Daughter[/i] and fine-tuning some aspects of the game. We have just opened an access to the beta build of [i]My Lovely Daughter[/i] so that you can try out the update before we push it to the public main branch. 

Current beta update:
[list]
[*]Added controller support (Xinput: e.g. Xbox One or Xbox 360 joystick)
[*]Our composer has fine-tuned most of the BGM and SFX
[*]Added new villagers art, their expression will respond accordingly based on request results
[/list]

You can try out the beta build by right-clicking the [i]My Lovely Daughter[/i] application in your Steam Library. Left-click Properties, then choose the "Betas" tab. Choose "public-beta" from the drop-down menu then close the window.

We are still working on some other new features, and will update the beta build accordingly and inform you if something new is implemented. Join further discussions of the update and the whole game in general by visiting the Steam forum or [url=https://discord.gg/toge]join our Discord channel[/url].

notes.title: New feature, items, endings, and soundtrack DLC!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31818974/4c5c14aa1055311e1d728d151fffe4d5f32eb59a.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

How’s your journey with Faust so far? If you are longing for more content to help Faust reviving his daughter, or if you have done everything the game has to offer, then we have a good news for you.

As some of you might have noticed, we just rolled out a new update for My Lovely Daughter. The update was made to address the issue of repetition and will help players to not only finish the game but also to help find all of the game’s endings. For those players who have already unlocked all of the story conclusions, we also have prepared two new endings to be discovered.

Here are the details of the new updates:

[list]
    [*][b]New Feature -[/b] Homunculi job initiative based on their level and affection. Homunculi will ask Faust whether they can work in a place that they like, automating some activities in the later part of the game and help you focus on other stuff in the game
    [*][b]New items -[/b] Wreath of Ecstasy and Cursed Twig. Both items are used to increase the affection of all homunculi and lower the rate of affection loss caused by work
    [*][b]New endings -[/b] We also have added two new endings to be discovered. We won’t spoil it for you, but both endings got something to do with alternative closure for Faust
[/list] 

Last but not least, to accompany your extended journey and expand your experience with My Lovely Daughter, we have just released the soundtrack and digital artbook of the game as a DLC. You can get the DLC through the Steam store link below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/832580/My_Lovely_Daughter__OST_and_Artbook/

That’s all from us. Hope you have fun with this addition we made and don’t forget to join our discord channel at [b]discord.gg/toge[/b] to have a nice discussion with the developers and other players of My Lovely Daughter.

Thank you.
